# Charleston Mortgage Blog

> Charleston, SC home buying and mortgage insights: local market reports, neighborhoods, flood zones, historic homes, and purchase, refinance, FHA, VA, USDA and HELOC loans.

This blog is published by Coastal Funding Corporation, a mortgage broker. Articles are informational and are not a commitment to lend; rates and programs are subject to change.
